What is Sift?

Sift is your personal agent for memecoin discovery and monitoring. Tell it what matters to you, review your rules, and get matching contract addresses with the reasons behind each result. All in Telegram.

BEFORE YOU HEAD IN

A little
more context.

Building carefully.
Testing with real feedback.

Can I use Sift right now?+

Sift is in private testing with approved accounts. You can open the Telegram bot, but access is currently limited. Public access and pricing have not been announced.

Is this website running a live scan?+

No. The pixel mascot is an interactive visual simulation, and the walkthrough uses illustrative examples. Actual discovery and monitoring happen in the Telegram bot while it is running.

What can Sift check today?+

The private test includes market snapshots, supported discovery rules, selected liquidity and wallet evidence checks, and market monitoring. Complete bundle detection and universal lock verification are not available. Reports identify supported evidence and unknowns.

How does Sift use my description?+

Describe your criteria or use guided setup. Sift prepares a draft for you to review before starting a scan. Optional hosted AI interpretation depends on the bot’s configuration; it does not replace the evidence checks.

Can I add Sift to a Telegram group?+

Group alerts are part of the private test. An eligible group admin configures the agent privately, verifies the group and enables alerts. Adding the bot alone does not start discovery or send alerts.

Will Sift guarantee a safe or profitable coin?+

No. A match means the supported checks met your rules using the available data. Coverage, data freshness and unknown risks still matter. Sift provides research context and does not execute trades.
